newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ARAGONES TO STAY ON AS VALENCIA COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ARAGONES TO STAY ON AS VALENCIA COACH.

text.p: Valencia coach Luis Aragones was given a vote of confidence by the club's board of directors on Tuesday.
"What the Valencia family needs now is to win," said chairman Paco Roig after the three-hour special meeting.
Aragones's position at the club had been put in doubt by conflicts with Roig over the decision to sign Brazilian striker Romario and a run of poor results.
